Skulpt is an open-source implementation of Python in JavaScript.
Vendored files downloaded from the official Skulpt website on 2026-10-19:
https://skulpt.org/js/skulpt.min.js
https://skulpt.org/js/skulpt-stdlib.js

Project: https://github.com/skulpt/skulpt
License source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skulpt/skulpt/master/LICENSE
The original license is preserved in SKULPT-LICENSE.txt.

The lesson executes Python 3 syntax supported by Skulpt in a dedicated
Web Worker. No network is required after this project has been saved locally.
